-- push box: three handmade levels
w=10
h=8
cell=12
bx=4
by=18
anim_dur=4
levels={
"##########\n#        #\n#  .  .  #\n#        #\n#  $  $  #\n#    @   #\n#        #\n##########",
"##########\n#   #    #\n# $ # .  #\n#   #    #\n#  @#    #\n#        #\n#        #\n##########",
"##########\n#        #\n#  ###   #\n#  $.#   #\n#   $    #\n#    @   #\n#   .    #\n##########"
}
function grid_input_reset()
 grid_prev={}
 grid_opposite={1,0,3,2}
 grid_dir=-1
 grid_wait=0
end
function grid_request(delay,interval)
 local fresh=-1
 local fallback=-1
 for i=0,3 do
  local down=btn(i)
  local valid=down and not btn(grid_opposite[i+1])
  if valid then
   if down and not grid_prev[i] and fresh<0 then fresh=i end
   if fallback<0 then fallback=i end
  end
  grid_prev[i]=down
 end
 local d=fresh
 if d<0 and grid_dir>=0 and btn(grid_dir) and not btn(grid_opposite[grid_dir+1]) then d=grid_dir end
 if d<0 then d=fallback end
 if d<0 then grid_dir=-1 grid_wait=0 return -1 end
 if d!=grid_dir then
  grid_dir=d
  grid_wait=max(1,delay or 6)
  return d
 end
 grid_wait-=1
 if grid_wait<=0 then
  grid_wait=max(1,interval or 3)
  return d
 end
 return -1
end
function edge(b) return btn(b) and not prevb[b] end
function cell(x,y)
 if x<0 or x>=w or y<0 or y>=h then return 1 end
 return tiles[y*w+x]
end
function box_at(x,y)
 for i=1,#boxes do
  if boxes[i].x==x and boxes[i].y==y then return i end
 end
 return 0
end
function home_count()
 local n=0
 for i=1,#boxes do
  if cell(boxes[i].x,boxes[i].y)==2 then n+=1 end
 end
 return n
end
function make_snap()
 local s={x=px,y=py,mv=moves,ps=pushes,b={}}
 for i=1,#boxes do
  add(s.b,{x=boxes[i].x,y=boxes[i].y})
 end
 return s
end
function apply_snap(s)
 px=s.x
 py=s.y
 moves=s.mv
 pushes=s.ps
 for i=1,#s.b do
  boxes[i].x=s.b[i].x
  boxes[i].y=s.b[i].y
  boxes[i].ox=boxes[i].x
  boxes[i].oy=boxes[i].y
 end
 pox=px
 poy=py
 anim_t=0
 pending=-1
end
function load_level(n)
 local rows=split(levels[n],"\n")
 tiles={}
 boxes={}
 goals=0
 for y=0,h-1 do
  local r=rows[y+1]
  for x=0,w-1 do
   local c=sub(r,x+1,x+1)
   local m=0
   if c=="#" then m=1 end
   if c=="." or c=="*" or c=="+" then m=2 goals+=1 end
   tiles[y*w+x]=m
   if c=="$" or c=="*" then add(boxes,{x=x,y=y,ox=x,oy=y}) end
   if c=="@" or c=="+" then px=x py=y pox=x poy=y end
  end
 end
 hist={}
 moves=0
 pushes=0
 pending=-1
 anim_t=0
 nope_cool=0
 grid_input_reset()
end
function nope()
 if nope_cool<=0 then
  sfx(22,3)
  nope_cool=10
 end
end
function try_move(d)
 local dx=0
 local dy=0
 if d==0 then dx=-1 end
 if d==1 then dx=1 end
 if d==2 then dy=-1 end
 if d==3 then dy=1 end
 local nx=px+dx
 local ny=py+dy
 if cell(nx,ny)==1 then nope() return end
 local bi=box_at(nx,ny)
 if bi>0 then
  local tx=nx+dx
  local ty=ny+dy
  if cell(tx,ty)==1 or box_at(tx,ty)>0 then nope() return end
  add(hist,make_snap())
  if #hist>40 then deli(hist,1) end
  boxes[bi].ox=boxes[bi].x
  boxes[bi].oy=boxes[bi].y
  boxes[bi].x=tx
  boxes[bi].y=ty
  pushes+=1
  sfx(20,3)
 else
  add(hist,make_snap())
  if #hist>40 then deli(hist,1) end
  sfx(19,3)
 end
 pox=px
 poy=py
 px=nx
 py=ny
 moves+=1
 run_moves+=1
 anim_t=anim_dur
 if home_count()==goals then
  state="clear"
  clear_t=45
  pending=-1
  sfx(24,3)
 end
end
function do_undo()
 if #hist==0 then nope() return end
 local s=hist[#hist]
 deli(hist)
 apply_snap(s)
 run_moves=max(0,run_moves-1)
 sfx(21,3)
end
function play_update()
 if anim_t>0 then anim_t-=1 end
 local req=grid_request(8,5)
 if req>=0 then pending=req end
 if anim_t<=0 and pending>=0 then
  local d=pending
  pending=-1
  try_move(d)
 end
 if state!="play" then return end
 if edge(5) then do_undo() end
 if edge(4) then load_level(level) sfx(23,3) end
end
function start_run()
 level=1
 run_moves=0
 load_level(1)
 state="play"
 music(8,200,7)
 sfx(23,3)
end
function _init()
 prevb={}
 state="title"
 level=1
 run_moves=0
 load_level(1)
 music(8,200,7)
end
function _update()
 if nope_cool>0 then nope_cool-=1 end
 if state=="title" then
  if edge(4) then start_run() end
 elseif state=="play" then
  play_update()
 elseif state=="clear" then
  if anim_t>0 then anim_t-=1 end
  if edge(4) then clear_t=0 end
  clear_t-=1
  if clear_t<=0 then
   level+=1
   if level>#levels then
    state="win"
    music(-1,200)
    sfx(25,3)
   else
    load_level(level)
    state="play"
    sfx(23,3)
   end
  end
 else
  if edge(4) then start_run() end
  if edge(5) then state="title" music(8,200,7) end
 end
 for i=0,5 do prevb[i]=btn(i) end
end
function draw_board()
 local t=1
 if anim_t>0 then t=1-anim_t/anim_dur end
 for y=0,h-1 do
  for x=0,w-1 do
   local cx=bx+x*cell
   local cy=by+y*cell
   if tiles[y*w+x]==1 then
    sspr(64,0,8,8,cx,cy,cell,cell)
   else
    sspr(72,0,8,8,cx,cy,cell,cell)
   end
  end
 end
 for y=0,h-1 do
  for x=0,w-1 do
   if tiles[y*w+x]==2 then
    circ(bx+x*cell+6,by+y*cell+6,4,10)
    circfill(bx+x*cell+6,by+y*cell+6,1,10)
   end
  end
 end
 for i=1,#boxes do
  local b=boxes[i]
  local dxp=bx+(b.ox+(b.x-b.ox)*t)*cell
  local dyp=by+(b.oy+(b.y-b.oy)*t)*cell
  if tiles[b.y*w+b.x]==2 then pal(9,11) end
  sspr(0,16,8,8,dxp,dyp,cell,cell)
  pal()
 end
 local pdx=bx+(pox+(px-pox)*t)*cell
 local pdy=by+(poy+(py-poy)*t)*cell
 sspr(32,0,8,8,pdx,pdy,cell,cell)
end
function _draw()
 cls(1)
 if state=="title" then
  draw_board()
  rectfill(6,28,121,100,0)
  rect(6,28,121,100,12)
  print("push box",48,36,10)
  print("3 small levels",36,50,7)
  print("press o to begin",32,64,11)
  print("arrows move  x undo",26,78,6)
 elseif state=="win" then
  draw_board()
  rectfill(8,30,119,98,0)
  rect(8,30,119,98,10)
  print("all clear!",44,38,10)
  print("steps "..run_moves,48,52,7)
  print("o play again",40,66,11)
  print("x title",50,80,6)
 else
  print("lv "..level.."/3",4,3,7)
  print("step "..moves,52,3,6)
  print("box "..home_count().."/"..goals,96,3,6)
  draw_board()
  if state=="clear" then
   local c=10
   if clear_t%20<10 then c=7 end
   rectfill(34,48,93,74,0)
   rect(34,48,93,74,c)
   print("clear!",52,54,c)
   print("o next",52,64,7)
  end
  print("x undo  o restart",28,118,6)
 end
end
title: 推箱子三关

design.core_action: 用方向键一次移动一格，走到箱子旁把它推向目标格；长按方向键在首步后按固定节拍重复。
design.goal: 依次解开3个手工小关，全部箱子落在目标格即过关；三关全通显示总步数。
design.risk: 推错方向或被墙挡住不消耗任何东西但浪费步数；箱子被推进墙角/通道会造成死局，需要用X撤销或O重开。第三关必须注意两个箱子的推动顺序。
design.controls: 方向键移动（首按立即，按住8帧后每5帧重复，换方向立即响应，相反键同时按互相取消）；X撤销一步；O重开本关；标题/通关页按O开始或再来；通关页X回标题。O与X使用严格上升沿，长按不重复触发。
design.scenes: title(展示第1关棋盘) → play(3关) → clear(短暂过关提示，可按O跳过) → win(总步数) → title 或重新开始。
design.audiovisual: BGM pattern 8 循环：SFX16 持续垫音(三角波，四行同音延续)、SFX17 低音、SFX18 稀疏伴奏，故意保留休止；声道3留给操作音效：19步、20推、21撤销、22受阻、23开始/重开/换关、24过关、25全通。箱子在各目标格时用 pal(9,11) 变绿。
preserve: 网格事务：只有合法动作才提交并压入历史
内置精灵 8/9 作墙与地板、精灵 4 作玩家、自定义精灵 32 作箱子
O/X 严格上升沿，长按不会重复重开或连续撤销
撤销上限 40 步，无历史时只给受阻反馈
unresolved: 长按重复节拍（8帧延迟/5帧间隔）与4帧移动动画的手感需实机试玩确认
BGM 的轻柔程度与音量需实际试听后再调整
